generations.transcript:
Reason for applying. Which of these best explains why you need an ITIN?

a. Nonresident alien required to get an ITIN to claim tax treaty benefit (you must also check and complete box h).

b. Nonresident alien filing a U.S. federal tax return.

c. U.S. resident alien (based on days present in the United States) filing a U.S. federal tax return.

d. Dependent of U.S. citizen or resident alien.

e. Spouse of U.S. citizen or resident alien.

f. Nonresident alien student, professor, or researcher filing a U.S. federal tax return or claiming an exception (if claiming an exception, you must also check and complete box h).

g. Dependent or spouse of a nonresident alien holding a U.S. visa.

h. Other (see instructions).
